meaning:
φιλοτιμέομαι, -οῦμαι
(φίλος, τιμή), [in LXX: 4Ma.1:35 A ;]
to love or seek after honour, hence, to be ambitious, emulous (Plat., Plut., al.): with inf., Rom.15:20, 2Co.5:9, 1Th.4:11.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.
Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.
and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you;
